# Diogo Silva

> Personal site of Diogo Silva, a B2B software salesperson based in Portugal. He writes about sales, artificial intelligence in day-to-day work, philosophy and faith, and photographs family, faith and memory under the name Bronze Art.

The site is hand-written static HTML and CSS: no JavaScript, no analytics, no tracking. Notes are published irregularly, in English and in European Portuguese. Contact: hello@diogobronzesilva.com

## Work

- [Work](https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/): Diogo's approach to B2B software sales, decision-making and AI-native sales workflows.
- Core idea: Sales is conversation.
- Core idea: Good sales helps people decide. It does not decide for them.
- Core idea: AI should remove the work around the conversation, not the conversation itself.

## Notes

- [Escassez de trabalhadores qualificados](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/escassez-de-trabalhadores-qualificados/): Em português. Porque falta mão de obra qualificada em Portugal: natalidade em quebra, um sistema de ensino desalinhado com a procura real, e uma cultura que tornou o risco de empreender menos atractivo. Publicado a 8 de Julho de 2022.
- [Bitcoin | The Fairy Tale](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/bitcoin-the-fairy-tale/): Why no currency removes the imperfection built into human exchange, because the imperfection was never in the ledger. Published 20 June 2022.
- [Panem et circenses](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/panem-et-circenses/): On the selectivity of online outrage, and why moral performance on social media rewards looking right over being right. Published 25 February 2022.
- [The Reign of Quantities](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-reign-of-quantities/): Quality asks for an artisan and time. Quantity asks for neither, which is exactly the trade modern production keeps making. Published 10 December 2021.
- [Efficiency, the One Ring to rule them all](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/efficiency-the-one-ring/): Efficiency has no natural ceiling. Left to itself it stops serving us and starts being served. Published 22 November 2021.

The Notes index also holds selected podcast and interview appearances under a Conversations section. These are treated as part of Diogo's intellectual and editorial work rather than as professional credentials. The RSS feed remains limited to published written notes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://diogobronzesilva.com/): Personal front door to Work, Photography and Notes.
- [Work](https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/): Sales, technology, decisions and the human part of the job.
- [Notes index](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/): Essays and selected conversations.
- [Contact](https://diogobronzesilva.com/contact/): Email address and links.
- [RSS feed](https://diogobronzesilva.com/feed.xml): Published written notes in RSS 2.0.

## Elsewhere

- [Bronze Art](https://bronzeart.pt): Diogo Silva's photography project. Classical, documentary photography of family, faith, and what gets handed down between generations.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/diogosilvae/): Professional profile and chronological career history.
